item.title: More water leaks reported today in Donegal
item.description: Uisce Eireann say repairs to a burst water main in South West Donegal may cause supply disruptions to Maas, Kilkenny, Ballyeriston, Loughfad and surrounding areas today. Works are scheduled to take place until 3pm this afternoon. Meanwhile, in Inishowen, mains repair works may cause supply disruptions to Coolcross, Cloontagh and surrounding areas until 2:15pm.
